args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Evening Book Club (7 PM at Local Library)
args.body:
Hi Frank,

I hope you’re well. I’d like to invite you to our book club meetings on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library. Right now we’re reading mystery novels and discussing a different book each week — everyone is welcome to join, whether you’ve read the book or just want to listen and contribute.

If you can make it, we’d love to have you join us. Feel free to bring any mystery recommendations.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class — Wednesday Evening
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I hope you’re doing well. I’d like to invite you to a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week. It’s on Wednesday evening and will focus on classic Italian dishes — you’ll get to cook along with the instructor and enjoy what we make.

If you can make it, please let me know and I’ll share the details (time and registration). Hope you can join!

Best,
[Your Name]
